fields.title: Parameter name
fields.description: A unique name for the input parameter. This name is exposed in the REST interface and in the Call Workflow node.

fields.title: Append unique ID to parameter name
fields.description: If checked, the name set above will be amended by the node's ID to guarantee unique parameter names. Usually it's a good idea to have this box not checked and instead make sure to use meaningful and unique names in all container nodes present in a workflow.

fields.title: Description
fields.description: A description for the input parameter. The description is shown in the API specification of the REST interface.

fields.title: Default value
fields.description:
The text representing a default JSON value. It might contain comments between 
/* */
or after # or // until the end of line.
